paragraphs: Hero checks. Villain bets $800 all-in. Hero tanks.
lve coached 100+ poker students. Every single one of them eventualy asks me what to do on blank rivers like this. There is no cut-and-dry answer. This is one of the toughest spots in poker.

I's best to start by considering pot odds. Hero has to risk $800 to win $1,600 and is thus getting 2-to-1 on his money. He needs to be right 1 in3 times to break even. How do you know if he’s right 33% of the time?

Start by counting Villain’s value combos. Most players will value-bet AA, K-K, 0-0, - eel eS on this river. Occasionally you'll run into A-4s, 5-45, eee or A-Ds, You'll have to assign ql weight to each of these wild Card hands bonis they won't always be in Villain’s range.
